enabled.description: Set false to skip deploy when running pnpm ios:build

deviceId.description: Physical device UDID or CoreDevice identifier. Leave empty to auto-select (prefers Wi‑Fi when preferWireless is true).

preferWireless.description: When true, prefer a device seen over the network (Connect via network in Xcode) over USB.

installTool.description: Install path: devicectl (Xcode wireless stack), ios-deploy, or auto (devicectl then ios-deploy).

noStart.description: Install only; do not start the app (recommended)
